independent_control.role: axis-parallel exact rational box-sweep cross-check only; it is not imported by the MC-020 implementation

authority.domain_profile: MC-A accepted current tranche: conventional lathe plus fixed-axis three-axis mill with explicit access/clearance witnesses
authority.sweep_semantics: S = closure(union over engaged source parameter/time of K(t)(T))

bounded_cutter_codec.meaning: finite nonempty union of strictly positive-volume axis-aligned boxes with exact rational local coordinates; holder/non-cutting boxes are encoded separately
bounded_cutter_codec.scope_boundary: covered deterministic subtype only; admitted arbitrary form/undercut source instances outside this codec retain PB-007-03

mill_form.route: exact fixed-axis stationary/line/polyline sweep for exact_rational_box_union_v1; MC-058 source-bound conservative route for admitted nonlinear motion

mill_accessible_undercut.route: same sweep route plus independent complete-body access/holder-clearance check against explicit retained-material/fixture obstacles

lathe_form_tool.route: covered local cutting/holder region is executable, but spindle rotational reduction and timed/phase-sensitive lathe process sweep are owned by MC-021/MC-022

exact_construction.algorithm: for each positive-volume cutting box and source line leaf, intersect the three exact rational parameter bands induced by x/y/z box inequalities using one shared source parameter

mc058_leaf_construction.input_requirement: each finite derived line leaf remains bound to its exact source interval and carries certified Euclidean translation error e from MC-058; semantic boundaries remain bound
mc058_leaf_construction.outer_rule: inflate every cutting box by e on each coordinate face; Euclidean translation displacement <= e implies coordinate displacement <= e, so this is a conservative superset
mc058_leaf_construction.inner_rule: erode every cutting box by e on each coordinate face when a strictly positive-volume core remains; that core is a conservative subset under any translation displacement <= e

access_witness.required_for: mill_accessible_undercut and any other cutter instance whose physical validity depends on access/holder clearance
access_witness.complete_body: cutting region plus separately encoded non-cutting holder region
access_witness.path: explicit finite continuous unengaged approach path before the cutting interval
access_witness.obstacles: explicit retained material and fixture regions that the complete body must not contact
access_witness.contact_policy: closed-set contact with a forbidden obstacle is collision
access_witness.target_material_note: material intentionally engaged by the later cutting interval is not mislabelled as a forbidden obstacle

blockers.reason: the admitted domain still lacks a universal finite exact source codec for arbitrary form/undercut cutting-region instances; MC-020's box-union subtype is not permission to narrow that domain

proof_boundary.PO-02: OPEN; MC-020 contributes a bounded form/undercut cutter and access slice only
proof_boundary.PO-04: OPEN; exact/validated global material-event classification remains downstream
proof_boundary.PO-05: OPEN; PB-007-03 and inherited general finite-progress obligations remain
